recipes.name: Easy Mango Avocado Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups peeled and diced ripe mango ((~ 11 oz / 320g diced mango, see Note 1))
½ cup (70g) diced Persian or English cucumber
3 tablespoons (45 mL) freshly squeezed orange juice
3 tablespoons (45 mL) freshly squeezed lime juice ((about 1 ½ limes))
Sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: In a medium to large bowl, combine the diced mango, red onion, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, jalapeños, orange juice, lime juice, and cilantro. Mix to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
If possible, allow the salsa to rest at room temperature (or in the fridge) for 20 to 30 minutes to allow the flavors to deepen.
Before serving, add the diced avocado and gently mix to combine, taking care to not smash the avocado. Taste for seasonings and adjust as needed.

page_recipe_notes: Notes This is about 3 medium ataulfo/honey mangos. If using larger tomatoes, dice or finely chop them about the same size as the cucumbers. For mild heat, use 1 and remove membranes/seeds before chopping. For spicy, use 2 to 3 and keep in the membranes/seeds.
